items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: And if you listen to Bunk, you know that he's extremely well-versed in chords.

ctx.x: Yeah, on the horn. On the horn, yeah. And if you listen to Bunk, you know that he's extremely well-versed in chords. A cornet isn't a chord instrument. When I'm talking about chords, I'm playing all the notes in a chord. Like playing a major chord. Even broken chords. Yeah, running the notes in a chord. Yeah. Oops, I think somebody's trying to break it. Yeah, wait a second.
Well, we're talking about chords now.
